newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares head for new record, eyes on BG Bank.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares head for new record, eyes on BG Bank.

text.p: Danish share prices rose in early trade on Friday, bolstered by the overnight Dow record with dealers foreseeing that the KFX index would hit new peaks in a market closely watching BG Bank.
"The U.S. rise seems bound to rub off on the Danish share market," one dealer said.
The BG Bank share was suspended early Friday awaiting a statement on mortgage credit firm Nykredit's alliance plans.
A newspaper reported that Nykredit's board would reject plans to strengthen its existing sales alliance with BG Bank.
The share closed three crowns up at 325 on Thursday on speculation of a possible full merger.
The KFX top-20 index had gained 0.43 point to 171.19 at 0745 GMT, having finished 0.49 point higher on Thursday at a new record closing high.
